Corollary
[Square-root bound on the cutoff-weighted curvature integral] For $t\in [t',t_2]$, \[ \int _{\gamma _t}\varphi k\, ds\le D_4\sqrt\delta , \] where $D_4$ depends only on the initial total-curvature and ambient bounds.
Proof

\sketch Integrate Claim 7 over an interval of length at most $\delta r^2$, using $\int _{\gamma _{t'}}kds<\delta $, $r<1$, and Gronwall.

□

Corollary
[Uniform bound on the curvature integral over short sub-arcs]
